name: nextjs-auth
description: Next.js Authentication based on Casdoor, live demo: https://nextjs-auth.casdoor.org

paragraphs: Everything that has to do with the login runs on the server, the browser only gets httpOnly cookies:
There is no session secret or session store, the session is the token Casdoor signed.

/login creates a random state and a PKCE verifier, keeps them in a short-lived httpOnly cookie and redirects to Casdoor.

/callback checks that the state is the one of this browser, exchanges the code for an access token on the server (with the PKCE verifier, so no client secret is needed), verifies the token's signature with the JWKS of Casdoor and keeps the token in httpOnly cookies as the session.
